description:
Running 'cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings' from the workspace root fails at:

  error: very complex type used. Consider factoring parts into 'type' definitions
   --> crate-jmap-jscontact-types/src/lib.rs:1735:20

The line:
  let cases: &[(&str, serde_json::Value, fn(&AnniversaryDate) -> bool)] = &[...];

Two clean options:
1. Add 'type AnniversaryDispatchCase = (&'static str, serde_json::Value, fn(&AnniversaryDate) -> bool);' just above the test fn and rebind 'let cases: &[AnniversaryDispatchCase] = &[ ... ];'. Pure refactor; no test behavior change.
2. Add '#[allow(clippy::type_complexity)]' on the test fn with a one-line rationale comment.

Option 1 is preferred per workspace style. Affects only the one test fn.

Filed from JMAP-6r7c review-loop session: noticed in passing while running workspace-wide clippy after closing out JMAP-6r7c.38. Out of scope for the base-client review epic but should not stay in the workspace clippy frontier indefinitely.
title: cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings fails on jmap-jscontact-types test type_complexity
